summary.oneLiner: Solarium delivered strong H1FY26 growth (43% revenue, 36% EBITDA) despite monsoon and GST 2.0 delays, with a pivotal 1GW module plant commissioning by mid-January 2026 set to drive 5-7% gross margin expansion via captive consumption and cost advantage, transforming its EPC model into a vertically integrated player.

hero.oneLiner: Solarium delivered strong H1FY26 growth (43% revenue, 36% EBITDA) despite monsoon and GST 2.0 delays, with a pivotal 1GW module plant commissioning by mid-January 2026 set to drive 5-7% gross margin expansion via captive consumption and cost advantage, transforming its EPC model into a vertically integrated player.

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: Residential: 32% revenue, expanded to 25+ cities via 450+ Solarium Saarthi franchisees; Government: 36% revenue, driven by NTPC/HPPL (defense delays were one-off); B2B Module Sales: emerging from Jan 2026; Trading: 70% of distribution segment (negative WC, low-margin)

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: INR229cr unexecuted (target completion by Q1FY27); INR209cr L1 (execution in 9-12m post-LOA); INR900cr bidding pipeline (mostly non-defense: NTPC, HPPL)

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: revenue growth: sustained EPC momentum (past 4x growth in 2 yrs); margin: 5-7% gross margin uplift from module captive use; order inflow: INR900cr pipeline; capex/commissioning: 1GW module plant commissioned by mid-Jan 2026

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: 1GW module plant enables captive supply (50%+ consumption target), B2C app for customer retention, BESS EPC bids active (no BESS manufacturing), franchisee network scaling

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: Structure manufacturing: 5% cost advantage → 0.3-0.5% EPC margin uplift; Module manufacturing: 12-13% standalone EBITDA margin; 5-7% gross margin uplift expected from captive consumption (modules = 50% of EPC cost); GST 2.0 cut to 5% boosts demand

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: IPO proceeds held as buffer for manufacturing WC (INR60-70cr needed in Q4); debt used for plant financing; no dividend or buyback mentioned; focus on balanced debt-equity

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Confident, transparent, and execution-focused; acknowledged one-offs (defense delays, GST slowdown); emphasized vertical integration as core strategy; no formal guidance but clear targets on utilization and margin uplift

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Defense receivables volatility (one-off resolved); module plant ramp-up risk (target 75% util by Q2FY27); competition from unorganized installers (96% market); DCR compliance post-June 2026 (plant capable); working capital pressure during ramp-up

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: Franchisee model (Solarium Saarthi) reduces capex risk while scaling reach; B2C app is CX tool, not revenue stream; trading segment (70% of distribution) is negative WC, subsidizing core EPC; defense delays were tied to Operation Sindoor (India-Pakistan conflict), not systemic
